{"code": "import pandas as pd

# Load the data
sales = pd.read_csv('data/sales.csv')

# Convert revenue to float after removing commas
sales['revenue'] = sales['revenue'].str.replace(',', '').astype(float)

# Remove QA orders (revenue == 999999.99)
filtered_sales = sales[sales['revenue'] != 999999.99]

# Check for refunded orders
refunded_count = filtered_sales[filtered_sales['status'] == 'refunded'].shape[0]

# Check how many converted = 1 and status = 'completed'
completed_converted = filtered_sales[(filtered_sales['status'] == 'completed') & (filtered_sales['converted'] == 1)].shape[0]

# Cross-tabulate channel vs customer_segment
cross_tab = pd.crosstab(filtered_sales['channel'], filtered_sales['customer_segment'])

# Compute conversion rate for each channel
conversion_rates = filtered_sales.groupby('channel')['converted'].mean()

# Compute difference in conversion rates (email - paid_search)
difference = conversion_rates['email'] - conversion_rates['paid_search']

# Print the results
conversion_rates, difference"}
